name: dsh-cli-session
description: Delegate implementation to a live local DeepSeek Harness session and supervise finalized outward output through bounded cursors.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to DSH and supervise output without duplicating worker work.
interface.longDescription: DSH CLI Session provides a loopback-only supervisory interface for stable assignment admission, output-only incremental waiting, compact lifecycle inspection, and bounded evidence reads over an already-running DeepSeek Harness web session.
